admin.noBookingsInRange: No reservations in this date range.
admin.importHint: Import expects a workbook with columns: Date (YYYY-MM-DD or D.M.YYYY), Time (HH:MM), Duration (min), Rink, Zone, Name, Email, Phone, and an optional Status (confirmed/cancelled). Handy for bulk-adding a recurring group booking — e.g. a kindergarten course's weekly ice time — download the template, fill in one row per date, and import it back.
admin.noScheduleConfig: No schedule is configured for this rink yet.
admin.scheduleSettingsHint: The break is cleaning/prep time between sessions — customers only ever see each session's own start-end time, never the gap itself.
admin.applyToRange: Apply to a range of days
admin.customScheduleActive: This day has a custom schedule.
admin.defaultScheduleActive: This day is using the default schedule.
admin.scheduleConflictWarning: Existing bookings at {{times}} on this date are no longer in the new schedule — check with those customers before saving.
admin.importScheduleHint: Columns: Rink, Date (YYYY-MM-DD or D.M.YYYY), Start Time (HH:MM), Duration (min). Rows sharing the same Rink+Date together replace that date's whole schedule.
admin.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
admin.signupNotice: Your account will need to be approved by a club owner or admin before you can manage reservations.
admin.signupError: Could not create account. The email may already be in use.
admin.pendingNotice: Your account has been created but doesn't have access yet. A club owner or admin needs to approve it — check back later.
admin.confirmDeleteStaff: Permanently delete {{name}}'s account? This also removes their login and cannot be undone.
admin.trainerInvitesHint: A trainer needs one of these single-use codes to sign up — keeps the pending list free of anyone who just finds the signup page.
admin.trainerSignupNotice: You'll need a single-use invite code from the club owner to sign up. Your account will need to be approved before you can manage training sessions.
admin.invalidInviteCode: This invite code is invalid or has already been used.
admin.appQrDesc: A static code that always opens the app's home screen — good for posters, the front desk, or business cards.
admin.zoneQrDesc: One code per zone — scanning it opens the booking page filtered to just that zone's available times. Good for posting at each part of the rink.
admin.slotQrDesc: Pick an exact zone, date, and time to generate a one-tap registration code — scanning it opens the sign-up form directly for that slot, with nothing else to pick. Good for open-ice / walk-in sessions.
